title: PACusage parameters
description: Condition-blind PAC discovery and differential polyadenylation usage analysis.

input.description: Sample sheet (TSV) with sample_id, alignment, condition, and control columns. Alignment paths are relative to the sheet.

assembly.description: Genome assembly name, used in PAC IDs (for example GRCh38).

fasta.description: Uncompressed genome FASTA. It is indexed in the work directory and never modified.

gtf.description: GTF or GFF3 gene annotation. A gene's name comes from gene_name, from Name on gene records, or from gene; a gene without one is named by its gene_id.

known_pacs.description: Optional BED6 of known PACs. Each record's PAC is its 3' edge in transcript orientation: end on +, start on -.

chromosome_aliases.description: Optional two-column TSV mapping alignment contig names to FASTA and annotation names.

layout.description: SE, PE, or auto to detect from each alignment. A layout column in the sample sheet overrides it.

strandedness.description: forward, reverse, or auto to infer from reads over annotated exons. The sample sheet can override it.

library_profile.description: generic_3prime calibrates every compatible evidence source; plasmidsaurus_3prime expects single-end, forward read_3p proximal tags; exact_boundary is for assays that keep the transcript/poly(A) junction.

endpoint_model.description: auto lets calibration choose; exact_boundary or proximal_tag requires one.

evidence_source.description: auto, or read_3p, read_5p, fragment_3p (paired-end), or polyA_junction to require that source.

min_mapq.description: Minimum mapping quality for a read to count.

require_unique.description: Skip reads whose NH tag reports more than one alignment.

require_proper_pair.description: For paired-end data, require the proper-pair flag.

excluded_contigs.description: Contigs ignored by every step, by alignment name or chromosome_aliases target. The default removes mitochondrial contigs under their common names; a supplied list replaces the default, and [] keeps every contig.

min_replicates_per_condition.description: Biological replicates each modeled condition needs.

insufficient_replicates_policy.description: error stops a run with too few replicates; warn marks its comparisons exploratory and suppresses confirmed gained and lost calls.

strand_min_informative_fragments.description: Reads over unambiguous exons needed to infer strandedness.

strand_decision_fraction.description: Share of informative reads in one orientation needed to call strandedness.

calibration_min_genes.description: Calibration genes (genes whose transcripts share one annotated end) each sample needs.

calibration_max_distance.description: Largest distance (nt) from an annotated end at which a read end counts toward calibration; also the kernel's half-width.

calibration_quantile_low.description: Lower quantile of the calibration offsets; with the upper one it bounds the central interval.

calibration_quantile_high.description: Upper quantile of the calibration offsets.

calibration_min_kernel_correlation.description: Minimum leave-one-sample-out kernel correlation for an evidence source to be usable.

calibration_min_model_margin.description: For generic_3prime, how far the best source's median correlation must exceed the runner-up's.

exact_max_median_abs_offset.description: Largest absolute median offset (nt) classified as an exact boundary.

exact_max_central_width.description: Widest central interval (nt) classified as an exact boundary.

exact_min_boundary_fraction.description: Share of read ends within 1 nt of the annotated end needed for an exact boundary.

proximal_min_median_upstream_offset.description: Minimum median upstream offset (nt) for a proximal-tag classification.

pac_seed_radius.description: Radius (nt) over which exact-boundary seeds are ranked.

pac_cluster_radius.description: Radius (nt) an exact-boundary PAC claims around its seed; also the assignment radius when counting.

pac_min_total_count.description: Reads a candidate PAC needs across all samples.

pac_min_sample_count.description: Reads a sample needs at a candidate to count as supporting it.

pac_min_supporting_samples.description: Required qualifying support within at least one condition. Values in (0, 1) are fractions of that condition's samples, rounded up; whole numbers are absolute sample counts.

known_pac_rescue_total.description: Reads a known PAC needs to be kept as known_rescue_only when it misses pac_min_total_count.

known_pac_match_radius.description: Distance (nt) within which a PAC matches a known PAC.

proximal_kernel_overlap_threshold.description: Kernel self-overlap at which two proximal-tag peaks count as resolved; it sets the minimum resolvable separation.

proximal_assignment_likelihood_ratio.description: How many times likelier the best PAC must be than the next for a proximal-tag read to be assigned.

proximal_bin_size.description: Bin width in nucleotides for proximal-tag regional peak discovery.

internal_exon_end_filter.description: For proximal-tag libraries, reject candidates made by reads ending at the 3' end of an internal exon in the annotation.

constitutive_readthrough_filter.description: For proximal-tag libraries, reject candidates whose reads end in an exon block that reads splice directly onward from, in every condition that supports the candidate.

constitutive_readthrough_min_junction_co.description: Splice-continuation reads, pooled over a supporting condition's samples, that show the condition splices onward from the exon block.

max_downstream_distance.description: Largest distance (nt) past a gene's end at which a PAC is still assigned to that gene.

pas_scan_upstream_far.description: Far edge (nt upstream of the PAC) of the window scanned for PAS motifs.

pas_scan_upstream_near.description: Near edge (nt upstream of the PAC) of the PAS scan window.

pas_core_upstream_far.description: Far edge of the core window where a PAS motif is expected.

pas_core_upstream_near.description: Near edge of the core PAS window.

pas_motif_catalog.description: Optional TSV of motif, class, and priority that replaces the built-in PAS catalog.

internal_priming_window.description: Genomic window (nt) downstream of a PAC checked for internal priming.

internal_priming_max_a_run.description: Longest A run in that window before a PAC is flagged as possible internal priming.

internal_priming_max_a_fraction.description: Highest A fraction in that window before a PAC is flagged as possible internal priming.

min_gene_total.description: Reads a gene needs across a comparison family to be tested. Motif scores and the report's PAU QC use genes with this many reads in every sample.

min_site_count.description: Reads a PAC needs across a comparison family to be tested.

min_site_usage.description: Share of its gene's reads a PAC needs to be tested.

min_test_supporting_samples.description: Samples with reads that a PAC needs to be tested.

model_covariates.description: Sample-sheet columns added to every model as categorical covariates (for example batch).

gene_fdr.description: Gene-level FDR for each treatment-versus-control screen.

site_fdr.description: Stage-wise PAC-level FDR within screened genes.

min_abs_delta_pau.description: Smallest absolute change in PAU that counts as an effect for event calls.

dm_bootstrap_replicates.description: Parametric bootstrap replicates for change-in-PAU intervals; 0 skips the intervals.

dm_bootstrap_min_success_fraction.description: Share of bootstrap replicates that must succeed for an interval to be reported.

dm_bootstrap_include_candidates.description: Also calculate bootstrap intervals for pre-statistical gained/lost candidates. Set false to retain intervals only for genes passing gene_fdr.

dm_zero_sensitivity_repeats.description: Refits, with zero counts perturbed, for genes that have a group without reads for a PAC.

dm_zero_max_delta_pau_spread.description: Largest spread of change in PAU across those refits before a PAC is flagged zero_boundary_unstable.

random_seed.description: Seed for every random step; a run is reproducible for a given seed and atlas.

event_min_treatment_pau.description: Fitted PAU a PAC needs in the gaining group for a gained or lost call.

event_max_control_pau.description: Highest fitted PAU in the other group for a gained or lost call.

event_min_supporting_samples.description: Samples with reads a group needs for a PAC to count as detected there.

potential_internal_priming_withheld_call.description: Let a gain or loss withheld only because its PAC is flagged for possible internal priming support the _potential_internal_priming APA patterns.

motif_preference_min_genes.description: Informative genes each sample of a comparison needs for a motif class to be tested.

motif_kmer_length.description: k for the exploratory k-mer enrichment.

save_prepared_reference.description: Publish the prepared FASTA and its index to outdir/prepared_reference.

save_prepared_alignments.description: Publish prepared alignments and indexes to outdir/prepared_alignments.

save_intermediates.description: Publish per-sample PAC count tables to outdir/counts/per_sample.

statistics_cpus.description: CPU cores allocated to each family-wide DRIMSeq fit and zero-boundary sensitivity pass.

statistics_bootstrap_cpus.description: CPU cores per scattered bootstrap batch. Each batch keeps bootstrap replicate parallelism within this allocation.

statistics_bootstrap_batch_size.description: Number of genes per scattered bootstrap batch.

statistics_bootstrap_max_forks.description: Maximum concurrent scattered bootstrap batches across the workflow.

slurm_queue_size.description: Most jobs Nextflow keeps queued at once.

slurm_submit_rate.description: Job submission rate limit, for example '10 sec'.

scratch.description: Shared scratch directory. When set, the work directory is <scratch>/pacusage-work and tasks run there.

bind_paths.description: Host directories bind-mounted into Apptainer at the same path, for inputs outside its default mounts. Give a YAML list in analysis.yaml.

container.description: Apptainer image. Defaults to containers/pacusage.sif in the pipeline directory.
